gold_note: Ceratosaur time tree, root at the bottom, with the abelisaurid base read at 2x (Rugops, Abelisaurus and the majungasaurine group branch off one after another, on horizontals a few pixels apart). Ceratosauria, Abelisauroidea, Noasauridae, Abelisauridae and Brachyrostra, beside node dots, are kept as internal labels. Polytomies: Ceratosauria (Deltadromeus, Berberosaurus and the rest), Noasauridae (four), Majungasaurus-Indosaurus-Rajasaurus, Skorpiovenator-Ilokelesia-Ekrixinatosaurus. The grey bars are ghost lineages on the stems, and Spinostropheus' dashed line is its range. 24 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 4, 3, 3 children); 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 5 case (census 2, seed 20261215). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
